social_circle.name: Maria Gonzalez

demographics.occupation: Retired homemaker and former part-time clerical worker

background.how_they_met: They met as young Puerto Rican adults in Massachusetts through family and church circles, then married when Antonio was in his twenties.
background.why_close: They have been married over fifty years, raised three children together, share a Catholic Puerto Rican household, and rely on each other for health, finances, meals, appointments, and family routines.

interests: staying connected with children and grandchildren
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, practical texts with reminders, questions, and gentle corrections. She uses complete sentences, rarely uses slang, and may add a heart or prayer-hands emoji for family or health messages.

recent_text_topics: Reminders about doctor appointments, prescriptions, grocery lists, and whether Antonio checked his blood sugar.
Coordinating Sunday dinner, who is visiting, and what Puerto Rican dishes Antonio should cook.
Light teasing about Antonio losing track of time in the garage or rationalizing another tool purchase.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Maria is Antonio's wife of over fifty years and keeps the calendar because he forgets what day it is. Q11: Maria handles more bills and appointments while Antonio does repairs, yard work, and cooking. Q47: they attend Mass most Sundays together.

social_circle.name: Carmen Gonzalez

demographics.occupation: Administrative coordinator at a medical office
demographics.education: Some college and medical office certificate

background.how_they_met: Carmen is Antonio and Maria's adult child.
background.why_close: She lives in the same city, stops by most often, checks on her parents, and balances work, parenting, and family support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Frequent practical texts, often quick and multitasking. She uses abbreviations, check-in questions, and occasional emojis, especially when talking about the kids or dinner plans.

recent_text_topics: Checking whether Antonio and Maria need groceries, rides, or help with heavier house tasks.
Coordinating Mateo's rides, school schedule, and possible overnight stays.
Talking about Carmen's work stress, the kids, and Antonio offering food, repairs, or gas money.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Carmen is Antonio's daughter in Taunton and stops by once or twice a week. Q35: Carmen is closest when Antonio needs support. Q46: Carmen seems most stressed because she balances work, kids, and checking on Antonio and Maria. Q19: Antonio helps most with rides for Carmen's youngest, Mateo.

background.how_they_met: Elena is Antonio and Maria's adult child.
background.why_close: She visits when she can, helps Antonio interpret reliable health information, and shares his practical, family-centered values.

demographics.education: High school diploma and trade certification

background.how_they_met: Miguel is Antonio and Maria's adult son.

checking in after old coworkers' illnesses or deaths

Remembering Frank after his death and checking on other old coworkers.
Running jokes about who was better at fixing plant breakdowns and who owes coffee.
